extra.text: A tower party needs two beef stews before it climbs. Deliver them to any village quartermaster on the route.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Seal the bowls well. Provisions spilled on the first stair feed nobody.

decline.text: No fault. The expedition will leave later rather than climb hungry.

in_progress.text: Two prepared stews are enough; this is provision, not a feast.

ready.text: The rations are packed? Any village quartermaster may receive them.

extra.text: The upper stair now begins with full hands and fuller stomachs.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
